intent: Fill the repository root README.md from the implementation audit so users and maintainers can understand the current product, operate it safely, and distinguish implemented behavior from intended future capabilities.

included: Current three-layer architecture: Distribution CLI, installed Harness Runtime, and Source
Install, init, doctor, upgrade, recover, uninstall, and Harness command examples
Explicit current boundaries for latest-version discovery, external Skill materialization, Skill execution, and template promotion

acceptanceCriteria.observable: README.md is non-empty and explains purpose, architecture, Source contents, lifecycle usage, Harness usage, safety model, readiness levels, limitations, and development verification.

Every behavioral claim agrees with package.json, CLI help, lifecycle/runtime implementation, Distribution Manifest, and bundled Workflow; README does not claim that the CLI discovers npm latest, materializes remote Skills, executes Skills, or automatically promotes governance templates.
Documented Distribution and Harness command forms match their implemented help output; check:distribution passes after README becomes a packaged file.
No implementation, contract, Source, or architecture file changes are required because this task documents existing behavior only.

risk.mainRisk: README could overstate unimplemented synchronization or Skill execution behavior; acceptance explicitly requires those boundaries to be visible.
risk.rollback: Restore README.md; no product state or lifecycle-owned target is changed.
